name: Music 01 — The world wants to hear you
subject: The world wants to hear you
html:
The world wants to hear you

Hey {{artist_name}},

Fully Open is filling up with music. Artists are joining, tracks are landing, the radio is playing — and we want yours in the mix.

Somewhere on a hard drive, phone, laptop or studio computer there's probably something worth hearing.

Getting it onto Fully Open is ridiculously simple. Finished single? Great. Old demo? Absolutely. Something weird you recorded at 2am? Even better.

Once it's here, listeners can discover it — and it's there for us to hear when we're choosing music for Fully Open Radio, features and future compilation vinyl.

Put your first track out there

Let's hear what you've got.
Fully Open

name: Music 02 — We've heard the first ones
subject: We've heard the first ones. What else have you got?
html:
We've heard the first ones

Hey {{artist_name}},

You're in. There's music on your page and people can press play.

Now we're curious — what else have you got?

Another single. Something older. A demo. A track that never quite got the attention it deserved. Fully Open gives you room for 200 tracks and 20 albums for free, so two tracks can be the start rather than the whole story.

The more of your music that's here, the more there is for listeners — and for us — to discover.

Add another track

Keep them coming.
Fully Open

name: Release 01 — Got an EP or album?
subject: Got an EP or album?
html:
Got an EP or album?

Hey {{artist_name}},

There's something different about seeing your music sitting there as an actual release. Artwork. Track order. Its own page. An EP looks like an EP. An album feels like an album.

If you've already got tracks on Fully Open that belong together, turn them into a release in a few clicks. Brand new record? Brilliant. Six-year-old EP that deserves another life? Bring it back.

Make it a release

Fully Open

name: Version 01 — Working on a song right now?
subject: Working on a song right now?
html:
Working on a song right now?

Hey {{artist_name}},

Here's one of the bits of Fully Open we think is seriously cool. You don't have to wait until a song is finished before it belongs here.

Track Version Control lets you capture the whole thing — first idea, phone recording, rehearsal, demo, mixes and eventually the master.

Working on something today? Put today's version in. Add the next one when it changes. Suddenly you've got the entire creative history of a song, not just the polished file at the end.

One song. Every version. The whole story. This feature rocks.

Start with what you're making now

Fully Open

name: Version 02 — Don't lose the good bits
subject: Don't lose the good bits
html:
Don't lose the good bits

Hey {{artist_name}},

The finished master is only one part of a song's story. There are the demos, rehearsal takes, alternate mixes and the version where something unexpected clicked.

Track Version Control gives those moments a home alongside the finished track. Keep the good bits, and the path that got you there.

Explore Track Version Control

Fully Open

name: Gig 01 — Playing anywhere soon?
subject: Playing anywhere soon?
html:
Playing anywhere soon?

Hey {{artist_name}},

There's a big difference between hearing an artist and being in the room when they play.

Got dates coming up? Put them on Fully Open so someone discovering your music can go straight from “who is this?” to “where can I see them?” Pub. Club. Festival. Basement. Enormous arena with twelve articulated lorries of pyrotechnics. Whatever the room looks like, get the date out there.

Tell people where you're playing

See you down the front.
Fully Open

There doesn't have to be a big tour. A local gig, festival slot or tiny room with a brilliant sound system is worth sharing.

Add a future date

Put it alongside your music and give people another way into what you do.
